title: Consistent monitoring of quantum fluctuations
summary: Recent works on the decoherent histories formalism suggested that slow-evolving macroscopic quantities (extensive sums of local observables) in quantum many-body systems can be consistently monitored: The existence of past measurements does not alter future outcome distribution. Here, for Gaussian weak measurements, we show that fluctuations of macroscopic quantities cannot be consistently monitored in general, in contrast to their intensive mean value.
